for item in status['items'][:5]:
    offset = item['offset']
    text = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, offset-50), 200)
    print(f"Offset {offset}: {repr(text[:200])}")

print("\n\n=== Final diff content ===")
fd = await CONTEXT.search("[final diff]")
if fd['items']:
    offset = fd['items'][0]['offset']
    # Read a bit more to find the actual diff content
    text = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 3000)
    print(text[:3000])

# Let me also read the full agent message at the end
fin_msg = await CONTEXT.search("[final message]")
for item in fin_msg['items']:
    offset = item['offset']
    text = await CONTEXT.read(offset, 2000)
    print("FINAL MESSAGE:")
    print(text[:1500])
